full_inspection: All four complete native images of copy1site056 and copy2site132 were inspected. Every body line, formula, note digit, margin and punctuation mark was compared. The doubled upright of the group symbol, repeated typed script ell/Z/Q forms, round lowercase o subscripts and straight typed display arrow agree directly in the two images. The archive inscriptions differ.
original_transcription_comparison: Both original transcriptions were compared in full. Their body strings agree, with the same original single-Gamma simplification. Direct image comparison confirms the doubled-stem encoding already in checked copy1, now applied to copy2. Remaining source differences are scan metadata and archive56/132.

entries.decision: preserve the observed doubled-stem typed glyph
entries.reason: Both images show two close uprights below the top horizontal. The supplied copy2 single-Gamma rendering omitted that visible detail; no manuscript origin is inferred.
The lower-left inscriptions clearly read56 and132. No authorship attribution is made.
